messages:
Olivia (CS): quick heads up — we have an onboarding webhook failure affecting ~18% of new tenant activations since 08:04 UTC. Getting a draft comms + mitigation options together, tagging eng/sre for status.
Diego (Eng): looking now. root cause appears to be a stuck proxy queue in the eu-west pool. we've pushed a targeted proxy restart, monitoring.
Mike (SRE): confirmed queue backlog spike. ephemeral operator restart cleared ~70% of backlog. metrics still ~degraded for some customers, tracing on folks with >5 min processing.
Olivia (CS): thanks. can we confirm: is rollback to previous proxy release possible if restarts don't converge? need ETA and if we should tell customers to expect a follow-up in 1h.
Diego (Eng): rollback is safe but will require routing flip; est 25–35m including canary. if restarts finish within 15m we skip rollback.
Marco (AE): what should I tell my 3 enterprise accounts in EMEA on renewal watch? they asked earlier about onboarding reliability.
Olivia (CS): short answer to AEs: be transparent, offer scheduled pairing + warm handoff office hours, and an initial one-month service credit if SLA breached. full wording below.
Liam (Support): posting list of currently impacted tenants in the support sheet now — link: <https://internal/sheets/ONBOARD-IMPACT-7290001111> (internal only). will attach tenant IDs to the ticket.
CS Ops Bot: Ticket CS-7290 created for customer comms + credits calc. Assigned: Olivia.
Olivia (CS): suggested customer status message (short):
```
Hi — we're investigating a disruption affecting new tenant activations. Our engineers have applied an immediate mitigation; some activations may still be delayed. We're actively monitoring and will share a full update within 60 minutes. If your onboarding is time-sensitive, reply here and we'll prioritize. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Inference Support
```
Olivia (CS): suggested mitigation commitments: 1) offer dedicated office hours 2) priority ingest for affected tenants 3) one-month account credit for any account that failed to onboard in the window. need ops + finance approval for the credit template.
Mike (SRE): logs show few error signatures tied to connection retries to the internal auth service — we've enabled fallback routing for new requests so new activations should start succeeding within 10–20m.
Diego (Eng): can confirm fallback routing turned on at 08:28 UTC. continuing to watch KV cache warm-up.
Marco (AE): thanks. i'll draft a tailored note for my renewal-risk accounts that emphasizes our remediation + credit offer. keep me posted if rollback is required.
Olivia (CS): next steps: 1) Support to DM affected customers with the short status (Liam) 2) Eng/SRE continue mitigation and post final ETA (Diego/Mike) 3) CS to schedule office hours (Olivia) 4) Finance to pre-approve credit template (Olivia -> finance ping).
Liam (Support): starting outbound now. copying the short status. will include link to office hours sign-up once Olivia posts it.
CS Ops Bot: Update: fallback routing reduced activation failures to ~3% at 08:41 UTC.
Diego (Eng): final note — if failures dip below 5% for 20m we close the incident and send final comms with root cause summary. otherwise prepare for rollback.
Olivia (CS): draft final comms template (for follow-up):
```
Update: Mitigation applied and service restored for the majority of affected activations. Root cause: transient proxy queueing combined with auth retries during high burst. Action taken: targeted proxy restart + fallback routing; rollback prepared but not required. We're offering a one-month credit to tenants impacted between 08:04–08:35 UTC and scheduling office hours for any customers who need hands-on help. Full post-incident report will follow.
```
Olivia (CS): collecting feedback afterward — we'll run a 30-minute debrief with CS/Eng/Support to capture improvement actions and a short FAQ for AEs. Proposed debrief 09:15 UTC in #customer-success.
Mike (SRE): +1 to debrief. will bring the short timeline and logs.
Diego (Eng): i can provide deploy/rollback notes and the mitigation checklist.
Marco (AE): please ping when the credit wording is finalized so i can include it in renewal conversations.
Olivia (CS): will do. thanks everyone — i'll post the office hours link in 10m and update the ticket when the final comms go out. :wave:
